panels.description: Nexus lower route: Sitara’s TJ projects a heat map with one human-sized intermittent signature beyond a collapsed passage. Leave upper-left clear.
Nayah braces a safety line while Roman clears loose ice and Sitara crawls through; keep exit route visible and upper-left clear.
Sitara reaches Orien, frost-stiffened and near hypothermia beside a dead heater; battered analog watch visible. Keep face tired and understated; leave upper area clear.
Sitara places and activates a phone on the ice beside Orien; his eyes open slightly. Leave upper-left clear.

items.speaker: TJ
items.text: Heat source ahead. Human-sized. Motion intermittent.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: Three minutes. Then we pull you out.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: If you can call, call this.
